phases.name: Now until delivery
phases.description: About 10 minutes a day. Gentle, pregnancy-safe positions only.
ground_rules: Stay upright, seated, standing, or on your left side. No lying flat on your back, nothing face-down.
Light effort only, about 5 out of 10.
Breathe out on the effort. No breath holding.
Stop and rest if dizzy, short of breath, sharp pain, or tingling or numbness in the arm.
phases.late_pregnancy_flag: Worth a call the same day: a headache that is severe or new, will not ease with rest and fluids, or comes with vision changes, upper right belly pain, or sudden swelling.

phases.name: After you are cleared
phases.description: Strength building. Start once the provider clears exercise (commonly around 6 weeks postpartum). Do Phase 1 for the first week or two.
phases.warmup: 5 minutes of easy walking or arm circles

progression.change: 2 sets of everything, lightest band, 1-3 lb. Stop 3-4 reps before it gets hard.
3 sets as listed. Same weights. Last 2 reps should feel like work.
Move up one band color or add 1-2 lb on rows and face pulls. Form first.
Same load, slower tempo: 3 seconds lowering on every rep.
One more step up in load every 2 weeks, only if shoulders and neck feel good.

phases.flare_rule: If neck or shoulder pain flares for more than a day, drop back one step for a week.
